description: This file defines the CurrencyField class, which manages currency formatting, conversion, and display for a CRM system, including handling user-specific currency settings and formatting patterns.

classes.name: CurrencyField
classes.description: A class for handling currency formatting, conversion, and display within the CRM, supporting user-specific settings and multiple formatting patterns.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the currency object with user-specific currency settings, such as pattern, separator, symbol, and conversion rate.

methods.name: setNumberofDecimals
methods.description: Sets the number of decimal places for currency formatting.

methods.name: convertToUserFormat
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to the user's formatted currency string.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency value, optionally skipping conversion.

methods.name: getDisplayValueWithSymbol
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency value with the currency symbol appended according to user preferences.

methods.name: appendCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Static method to append the currency symbol to a value based on placement preference.

methods.name: _formatCurrencyValue
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a currency string based on user-configured pattern, separators, and grouping.

methods.name: getDBInsertedValue
methods.description: Returns the currency value formatted for database insertion, converting back from formatted string to numeric.

methods.name: convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Static method to convert a value into database format, optionally skipping conversion.

methods.name: getDBCurrencyId
methods.description: Retrieves the default system currency ID from the database.
